filing_office: Oklahoma Secretary of State, Business Filing Department
filing_fee_notes: Base filing fee. Form 0074 specifies a 4% credit-card service charge.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain an Oklahoma street office open during regular business hours. The agent may be the domestic LLC itself, an Oklahoma resident, or an eligible domestic or qualified foreign corporation, LLC or limited partnership; no P.O. boxes.
expedite_options: Form 0074 lists an additional 50 per document for same-day filings delivered in person.
annual_report_due: On the anniversary date of registration each year.
plain_english_summary: File Articles of Organization and maintain a registered agent. File the Annual Certificate on the registration anniversary.
common_mistake: Keep the LLC's email current; annual certificate notices are sent there.
notes: Scope: ordinary domestic LLC. Fees and rules were checked against the SOS's July 2026 formation packet and Annual Certificate form. Standard processing time, franchise or privilege tax treatment, publication requirements and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
